newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran's Khatami names Habibi in first cabinet post.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Khatami names Habibi in first cabinet post.

text.p: Iran's President Mohammad Khatami on Monday made his first cabinet appointment, naming Hassan Habibi as first vice-president, the same position he held under the previous president.
The official news agency IRNA said the appointment was announced in a presidential decree. Khatami was sworn in earlier on Monday.
Habibi served as first vice-president and government spokesman in the administration of outgoing president Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani.
